hook: AI helped find PHP flaws; it runs an estimated 70% of websites.
hooks: AI helped find PHP flaws; it runs an estimated 70% of websites.
Governments scrambled to patch PHP flaws that AI helped find.
The language is vital to an estimated 70% of websites globally.
what_happened: AI tools helped uncover critical flaws in PHP, used on an estimated 70% of websites. The PHP Foundation released fixes.
why_it_matters: Patching matters because PHP is estimated to run about 70% of websites, and the FBI warned the flaws could allow remote code execution.
the_catch: Patching is slow: it could take months or years before all stragglers are weeded out, because each site must be found first.
caption: AI tools helped uncover critical flaws in PHP, which an estimated 70% of websites rely on. Has a site you use ever gone offline?
alt_text: The slides explain that AI helped find critical flaws in PHP, which runs an estimated 70% of websites, and that fixes have been released.

es.hook: La IA ayudó a encontrar vulnerabilidades en PHP; PHP está presente en aproximadamente el 70 % de los sitios web.
es.what_happened: Herramientas de IA ayudaron a descubrir vulnerabilidades críticas en PHP, que está presente en aproximadamente el 70 % de los sitios web. La PHP Foundation publicó correcciones.
es.why_it_matters: Aplicar parches es importante porque PHP está presente en aproximadamente el 70 % de los sitios web, y el FBI advirtió que las vulnerabilidades podrían permitir la ejecución remota de código.
es.the_catch: Aplicar parches es lento: podría tomar meses o años antes de que todos los sitios rezagados sean actualizados, porque primero hay que localizar cada sitio.
